The urinalysis confirms infection with white blood cells present, and the elevated creatinine suggests kidney involvement. The presence of eosinophilic, binucleated cells on the cytospin is highly unusual and needs clarification; could you describe if you have any history of allergies or exposure to certain medications like NSAIDs or antibiotics recently?
